NEW signal: Trump 5/16 returning from Beijing said Xi 'agrees Iran must open strait', considering lifting US sanctions on Chinese oil companies buying Iranian oil — first explicit quid-pro-quo on table. CNBC 5/16: 'no sign China will weigh in' beyond rhetoric. (1) Iran 5/14 approved selective Chinese vessel passage through Hormuz via Persian Gulf Strait Authority permit (Fars/Tasnim/Inquirer) — material bilateral concession; (2) Trump-Xi Beijing summit 5/14-15 Hormuz-focused; (3) China sending special envoy for ME affairs to region; (4) Beijing dispatched envoys, evacuated nationals from Iran. Net: rhetoric ↑, selective Chinese transit permit + Trump sanctions-relief consideration are first material focal-point injections but no kinetic involvement.

NEW: Iranian media 5/18 reports US proposing temporary oil-sanctions waiver pending final agreement — Brent eased ~1%+ on report. (1) PROJECT FREEDOM PAUSED 5/5 after ~36hrs citing 'great progress' BUT (2) NAVAL BLOCKADE OF IRAN PORTS ACTIVE since 4/13 (M/day Iran losses per WH Op Economic Fury); (3) Competing 14-point proposals: US 14-pt (no enrichment 12yrs, hand over 440kg 60% HEU, gradual sanctions relief, blockade withdrawal, strait reopen 30 days post-signing) vs Iran 14-pt counter; (4) Trump 5/10 called Iran response 'totally unacceptable'; Trump 5/12 declared ceasefire 'on life support'; (5) Iran negotiator Ghalibaf 5/12 ultimatum; (6) FDD 5/11: US must open Hormuz by force as Iran's deal 'unacceptable'. Bifurcated track persists: PF paused (de-escalatory) ⊕ blockade ongoing ⊕ sanctions-waiver olive branch ⊕ rhetoric oscillating.

fp3_face_saving_framework.label: 面子工程原材料出现
fp3_face_saving_framework.findings: 5/19: Multiple competing framework tracks alive; sanctions-waiver hint widens off-ramp. NEW: Iranian media 5/18 — Trump considering temporary oil sanctions waiver pending final agreement (first concrete US olive branch since 5/10 rejection of Iran counter); also Trump 5/16 considering lifting sanctions on Chinese companies buying Iranian oil. (1) US 14-pt vs Iran 14-pt counter — Trump rejected 5/10 'totally unacceptable'; (2) Iran negotiator Ghalibaf 5/12 ultimatum: 'accept or face failure'; (3) Pakistan remains practical back-channel mediator with China political weight; (4) UNSC Resolution 2817 condemned Iran attacks 13-0-2 still operative; (5) Bahrain Hormuz-escort draft 4/7 vetoed by China+Russia; (6) Xi's 4-point ME peace plan still on table. Both sides retain face-saving exit ramps (14-pt proposals + sanctions waiver path), but neither has crossed acceptance threshold; framework production accelerating.

fp4_cost_threshold.label: 成本阈值的物理逼近
fp4_cost_threshold.findings: 5/19: Cost thresholds elevating, no political breakpoint yet. GAS — National avg $4.45/gal (+50% from pre-war ~$3.00 — NBC 5/11, AAA); Trump proposed federal gas-tax suspension 5/11 (NPR) — admin defensive. INFLATION — CPI ~3.8%, highest in nearly 3 years. WAR COST — Pentagon: $25B+ Iran war cost so far (NBC 5/14 Hegseth Armed Svc Committee); CAP estimate similar. CASUALTIES — 13 US service members KIA (cumulative since 2/28); no major new casualty events this week. WPR — May 1 60-day notification deadline passed; 6 Senate Dem WPR votes failed (latest 49-50); House WPR effort failed by 1 vote; admin argues 'hostilities terminated' since 4/7 ceasefire so 60-day clock doesn't apply; Trump asserting Article 2 authority via Hegseth Senate testimony. GOP cohesion narrow margins signal stress but holds. Public sentiment: Reuters/Ipsos 4/15-20 — 77% concerned about Iran situation.

noise_filter.rule: 按行为类型分类,不按人物分类
noise: 巴盖伊等发言人声明(言辞)
媒体'消息人士'报道(未验证)
signal: Trump签署行政令/军事命令(行动)
美军实际调兵/部署变化(行动)
IRGC实际攻击模式变化(行动)
中国实际经济/军事动作(行动)
noise_filter.key_distinction: 同一个人的言辞=噪声,行动=信号。Trump说'just for fun'=噪声。Trump命令打Kharg=信号。

pipeline_daily_checklist: 1. 物理层: 更新Q1(袭击频率) + Q2(通行量) + Q3(SPR释放)
2. 焦点层: 扫描fp1(中国动作) + fp2(美方矛盾) + fp3(退出框架) + fp4(成本阈值)
3. 噪声过滤: 新闻分类为action vs rhetoric
4. 结构性验证: 跑structural_verify检查盲区+停滞+链断裂
5. DAG更新: 只有物理层变化或焦点层信号触发才更新概率
